prompts.ayush: Use case: identity-preserve / style-transfer. Create a finished transparent PNG sprite for a 1997 first-person psychological-horror adventure. Image 1 is the identity reference: retain this man's recognizable swept black hair, thick eyebrows, face proportions, light moustache and chin beard, brown skin. Images 2 and 3 are STRICT rendering-style references: actual crude polygon geometry with low-resolution photographic textures, like early PlayStation NPCs. Reconstruct his WHOLE HEAD as a believable solid low-poly 3D head, roughly 80–150 triangles: angular forehead, cheekbone planes, wedge-shaped projecting nose, chin and visible side depth; hair is a chunky polygon cap textured with coarse hair pixels. Slight 15-degree three-quarter yaw, nearly frontal, very slight upward view to reveal volume. Face texture about 64–96 pixels across, limited colors and visible dither; strong faceted flat shading. Expression: quietly ominous, lips closed and almost-smiling, eye contact. The subject is ONLY a floating head, cut off cleanly just below chin, no neck, no shoulders, no body. Centered with ample empty margin, true transparent background, no shadow. NO pasted rectangular face photograph, no flat billboard, no cut-and-paste seams, no realistic skin pores, no smooth high-poly render, no cartoon emoji, no witch hat, no text, no border, no backdrop. Head must look like one coherent old 3D game model, preserving the person while fully changing the rendering medium.
prompts.patient: Use case: identity-preserve / style-transfer. Create a finished transparent PNG character sprite for a serious 1997 psychological-horror adventure. Image 1 is the identity reference: preserve this man's recognizable curly black hair, thick dark eyebrows, broad nose, face shape, brown skin and short beard. Images 2 and 3 are STRICT aesthetic references for low-poly early PlayStation NPC faces. Transform the identity into a coherent solid polygonal 3D floating head, roughly 80–150 triangles, visible flat-shaded planes, a properly projecting wedge nose, faceted cheeks/chin and an angular cap of curly hair represented by coarse texture. 64–96px face texture resolution, slight gritty dither, desaturated warm earth colors. Camera almost frontal with a subtle 10-degree yaw so head depth is visible. Expression: sad, exhausted and withdrawn; downturned closed mouth, heavy eyelids, gaze slightly lowered, subtle tired eye shadows. Human and sympathetic, understated sadness, NO smile, NO silly caricature, NO exaggerated crying. Only the complete floating head cut just below the chin: NO body, shoulders, neck, suit, chair or props. Centered with generous margin, true transparent background and no shadow. Avoid a flat pasted photograph, rectangular face plane, visible collage seams, realistic pores or glossy/high-poly rendering. The result must feel like a melancholy phototextured low-poly character from a lost 1990s game. No text, logos or scenery.
prompts.musicbox: Use case: stylized-concept. Single transparent PNG game prop: an OPEN antique wooden MUSIC BOX, immediately recognizable as a hinged rectangular music box, rendered as a very low-poly late-1990s PlayStation object with coarse 64x64 wood and brass textures. Small squat dark walnut rectangular chest on four angular brass feet; lid hinged open about 95 degrees; red velvet lining; exposed polygonal brass pinned cylinder and comb mechanism clearly visible inside; a small winding key sticking out the right side. Modest worn brass corner fittings and a little latch on the front. Perspective is slightly elevated frontal three-quarter, showing front, right side and interior. Low triangle count (roughly 100–200), flat shaded angular edges, uneven low-resolution photo-like wood textures, ordered dither, baked-in shadow only on the object itself. Unsettling abandoned toy but no gore. Whole object centered with ample margin on true transparent background. No hands, no room, no text, no ground shadow. Not a clock, not a pocket watch, no circular dial, no huge ornament, no photorealism, no modern high-poly bevels, no clean cartoon illustration. Usable standalone sprite for a surreal old game.
